releaseNotes: v1.2.3 -- Dashboard snapshot tiles: fixed going to a broken image icon on refresh, and fixed a slow/hanging follow-up issue on busy dashboards. Snapshots are now cached on the hub on their own schedule (new Snapshot interval device setting, default 30s, separate from Poll interval) instead of being fetched live from the camera on every tile refresh -- faster tiles, and no risk of camera calls backing up on this app's single-threaded execution. Fixed a scheduling bug where installs with multiple cameras could end up with only one camera actually polling, the others silently stopped with no error, and made the scheduler self-healing (automatically resumes after a hub reboot, and one device having a problem can no longer stop every other device from polling). Fixed new camera/doorbell devices always defaulting to the loose battery poll interval even when wired -- wired devices now correctly default to a tight interval. Fixed the Refresh command doing nothing. Fixed some commands (Set Poll Interval, Set Snapshot Interval) throwing an error instead of applying. Poll interval and Snapshot interval are now device-only settings -- the old app-level 'Default poll interval' options have been removed, since they only ever applied at the moment a device was first created and had no effect afterward; to change an existing device's interval, use its own device page (or the Set Poll Interval / Set Snapshot Interval commands). Also includes v1.2.2 (fixed dashboard snapshot tiles going to a broken image icon on refresh -- the old snapshot URL had the camera's session token baked directly into it, so it worked on first load but broke as soon as that token expired or got invalidated by another client logging into the camera (rspCode -6); this added an OAuth requirement to the app, which HPM enables automatically on update), v1.2.1 (diagnostic logging fix -- reolinkApiCall() previously logged every call as 'succeeded' whenever the HTTP request itself didn't error, even if the camera returned no usable value, masking real issues on devices intermittently failing to return AI/motion state; now logs the raw response body when a call gets an HTTP response but no usable value; no functional/behavior change, improves debug visibility only), v1.2.0 (PTZ calibration via calibratePtz/checkPtzCalibrationStatus, reorganized device page command grouping with model-dependent notes), v1.1.2 (debug logging for token lifecycle and poll transitions), and v1.1.1 (fixed a polling scheduler bug that could trip Hubitat's excessive-hub-load protection).
author: jdthomas24
